summary.text: Desireè Tims is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who has represented District 38 since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney and former congressional aide, she is the ranking member of the House Insurance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Desiree Tims was born in Dayton, Ohio, according to Ballotpedia.
She earned a B.A. in communications from Xavier University and a J.D. from Georgetown Law, and she attended the Women's Campaign School at Yale University.

Tims worked as a lobbyist and judiciary director at the League of Conservation Voters from 2017 to 2018, as a senior advisor to Child Care Aware of America from 2014 to 2017, as an aide to Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand (D) from 2013 to 2014, as an aide to Sen. Sherrod Brown (D) from 2011 to 2013, and as an associate and White House intern for President Barack Obama (D) from 2010 to 2011.
Tims assumed office in the Ohio House of Representatives on January 1, 2025, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.

In the 2025-2026 session she serves on the General Government, Workforce and Higher Education, House Judiciary and House Rules and Reference committees and is the ranking member of the House Insurance Committee.
